items.difficulty_reason: Double duality comes from the evaluation map and the perfect case of the evaluate-isom lemma; localizing and taking a strictly perfect representative, the Rhom-strictly-perfect lemma identifies K^ or  with the termwise dual complex, and the evaluation isomorphism reduces to the free-case tensor-hom adjunction for summands of finite free modules.
